status: Development conversion profile; not generally adopted
inheritance: Keep all header/payload/Float32/RGB/ordinal/material/work-budget rules. Replace only frame, representationToAsset admission, Asset bounds and point-anchor coordinate mapping as specified below.

frame.axis: Retain source RepresentationFrame and explicit mapping to the AssetFrame; no recentering or axis inference.
frame.unit: Make no physical-unit assertion. Preserve the exact ProjectFrame.unit object: {kind:unknown} or {kind:meters,metersPerProjectUnit:1}; no calibration or inferred scale.
frame.representationToAsset: Existing target canonical positive Sim3 plus reflection none/x; preserve values exactly. Reject noncanonical or nonfinite inputs; never normalize.

transform.linear: L = uniformScale * R(rotationXYZW) * diag(reflection == x ? -1 : 1, 1, 1); R is the standard quaternion matrix used by gsRotation, with XYZW reordered to WXYZ at that API.
transform.point: out[i] = ((L[i][0]*p[0] + L[i][1]*p[1]) + L[i][2]*p[2]) + translation[i]; IEEE754 binary64, finite output required, negative zero becomes positive zero.
transform.binding: AssetBinding is applied once later for display/Project coordinates; never include it in logicalBoundsAsset.

bounds: Exact component-wise min/max of every transformed post-Float32 source position. Retain separately the raw RepresentationFrame bounds for decoder verification.

records.pointSample: nodeIndex 0, primitiveIndex 0, original zero-based pointIndex; retain duplicates and row order.
records.sourceSemantics: Inherited opaque/surface/unlit/front, baseFactor [1,1,1,1], sourceAlpha 1, one synthetic RGB slot.

anchors: New direct pointSample anchors use the same checked transform into Asset coordinates. Existing Native manual Caption coordinates are already authoritative Asset/Project coordinates: do not transform or repick them.
presentation: Existing point-binary/dither/smooth profiles and controls remain unchanged; allow this exact new source profile in the existing unlit point capability rule.
